subject.title: [Bug]: Runtime tool surface returns blank body after gateway-touching operations; container restart only briefly clears it

question: What proof path should maintainers require before opening or landing a fix for the session-scoped blank-body tool-surface wedge?
rationale: The issue now has multiple credible current-release reproductions, but source inspection does not identify one narrow owner path and adjacent fixes only partially overlap.

options.title: Live-repro and isolate first
options.body: Use the available Telegram/webchat session IDs and gateway logs to identify whether the wedge is owned by locks, restart/compact lifecycle, prompt projection, or tool invocation before authorizing a fix PR.

options.title: Land the partial prompt fix first
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99524 as an adjacent mitigation while keeping this issue open until installed-session proof shows the broader wedge is resolved.

options.title: Add recovery/status surface now
options.body: Sponsor a product decision for user-facing session reset and tool health diagnostics even before the root cause is fully isolated.

recommendation.title: Live-repro and isolate first
recommendation.body: Use the available Telegram/webchat session IDs and gateway logs to identify whether the wedge is owned by locks, restart/compact lifecycle, prompt projection, or tool invocation before authorizing a fix PR.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has recent adjacent session-lock and tool-output history and is the best available routing owner for deciding the proof bar from the observed history.
